aub_upgrade_chain_citadel_thang_long_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = citadel_thang_long_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_citadel_thang_long_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 1000 }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = citadel_thang_long_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = citadel_thang_long_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 1000 }
		}
	}
}
